messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album Abbey Road?

Units:
- Only a Northern Song
- Within You Without You
- Kansas City/Hey-Hey-Hey-Hey!
- Can't Buy Me Love
- I'm Looking Through You
- Do You Want to Know a Secret
- Magical Mystery Tour
- Here Comes the Sun
